name: John Doe
subtitle: Senior Full Stack Engineer
about: I'm a full stack engineer passionate about building scalable web applications and developer tools. With over 8 years of experience, I specialize in modern JavaScript frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. I enjoy solving complex problems and mentoring the next generation of developers.
heroSummary: Building the future of web applications with modern technologies and best practices.

highlights: Led development of AI-powered analytics platform using React, TypeScript, and Python, serving 100K+ daily active users.
Architected microservices infrastructure on AWS using Docker and Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 60%.
Implemented real-time data processing pipeline with Apache Kafka and Redis, handling 1M+ events per day.
Mentored team of 5 junior engineers and established code review best practices.
Built customer-facing web application using Next.js and Node.js, increasing user engagement by 40%.
Designed and implemented RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints serving mobile and web clients.
Optimized database queries and implemented caching strategies, improving page load times by 50%.
Collaborated with design team to create responsive, accessible user interfaces.
Developed and maintained React-based dashboard for internal analytics tools.
Integrated third-party APIs and payment processing systems.
Participated in agile development process and sprint planning.
